request: Greedy word wrap: split the text on whitespace into words and fill lines left to right, joining words with one space and never exceeding `width` characters per line. A word longer than `width` goes on its own line unbroken. Return the list of lines. A width below 1 is invalid.

signature.python: def wrap_text(text: str, width: int) -> list[str]
signature.jig: def wrap_text(text: str, width: int) -> Result[list[str], str]
